CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.

===== Cleo: 512x16 SRAM macro (D058, D128, D129). Changes above: RUN_KLAYOUT_DRC 1, FP_PDN_VPITCH; the rest is added here =====
jspe_mem builds the macro by default (D131); -DJSPE_MEM_FLOP selects the 128x16 flop fallback.
Program memory u_mem.u_sram, flush bottom-left, FS = signal pins (Metal2) on its top edge, facing the logic.
Macro supplies: VDD! (periphery) and VDDARRAY! (bit cells) both to VPWR, VSS! to VGND.
src/pdn_cfg.tcl: column straps above the macro (stdcell grid), then after pdngen one Metal4 strap over each of the
40 supply columns, overlapping the core strap at macro top + halo (D129). pdngen alone cannot join same-layer macro pins.
Metal4 base stripes (centreline = core x 2.88 + offset + k*pitch) cross the macro only on supply columns:
Magic reads the macro from its LEF, whose Metal4 OBS bar at the VDD!/VDDARRAY! break (local y 39-45) every column strap crosses;
the GDS has no metal there. Magic DRC off and that overlap waived; KLayout DRC with the CMOS5L precheck deck instead.
PSM grid check and IR-drop report stay on (template defaults): with the straps the grid is connected (D129).
